_comment: Java symbols that Minecraft renamed between eras. validateEraSymbols fails when a version module in [since, before) contains a line matching pattern. CI compiles only 1.21.1 and 26.3, so these renames otherwise surface only in buildAll. Add a rule with the fixing commit whenever an era rename breaks a version that CI does not build.

rules.message: net.minecraft.resources.Identifier exists only on 1.21.11+. Use ResourceLocation here (983f6ce12)
ResourceLocation was renamed to net.minecraft.resources.Identifier in 1.21.11
BlockBehaviour.Properties.noCollision() exists only on 1.21.9+. Use noCollission() here
noCollission() was renamed to noCollision() in 1.21.9 (36fe8b368)
